mapper.sql: left join patient_info pi on rt.patient_id = pi.patient_id left join mp_person mp on pi.person_id = mp.person_id
mapper.select:
select rt.id, rt.patient_id, COALESCE(mp.person_name, rt.patient_name) as patient_name, rt.from_institution, rt.to_institution, rt.from_dept, rt.to_dept, rt.transfer_type, rt.transfer_date, rt.reason, rt.diagnosis, rt.accompanying_info, rt.transfer_status, rt.create_by, rt.create_time, rt.update_by, rt.update_time, rt.remark from referral_transfer rt
and (mp.person_name like concat('%', #{patientName}, '%') or rt.patient_name like concat('%', #{patientName}, '%')) and rt.transfer_status = #{transferStatus} and rt.transfer_type like concat('%', #{transferType}, '%') and rt.from_institution like concat('%', #{fromInstitution}, '%') and rt.to_institution like concat('%', #{toInstitution}, '%')
order by rt.id desc
